approval_reference: 2026-10-11 user approved the recommended E0b plan: reserve E2 with a global 20/80 household split and use local logical sealing for T labels

dataset_source.name: dunnhumby The Complete Journey
dataset_source.use_boundary: research/non-commercial; do not redistribute raw records

evaluation_policy.primary_activity_metric: Y1 average precision when identifiable; retain zero-positive and all-positive activities with explicit status
evaluation_policy.aggregation: equal-weight activity macro average with denominator and complete activity list
evaluation_policy.inference_scope: exploratory future-period response prediction; do not treat households as independent future campaigns

e2.assignment: sort unique eligible T households by sha256(seed:household_key), then household_key; first floor(fraction*N) are adaptation

label_policy.y1: at least one valid coupon_redempt row matching household, campaign, campaign coupon, and inclusive campaign dates
label_policy.y2: at least one legal positive purchase of a campaign target PRODUCT_ID during inclusive campaign dates
label_policy.y3: deferred until SALES_VALUE net/return semantics are independently confirmed

campaign_desc.csv.time_role: defines inclusive campaign outcome window and prediction cutoff

campaign_table.csv.time_role: participation assignment inherited from campaign dates

coupon.csv.time_role: campaign design known by the campaign prediction cutoff

product.csv.time_role: static taxonomy; observation time not independently recorded

transaction_data.csv.time_role: DAY before START_DAY is history; campaign-window DAY is auxiliary outcome only
transaction_data.csv.role: pre-cutoff behavior and auxiliary post-campaign outcomes

coupon_redempt.csv.time_role: completed D/R labels and sealed T labels within inclusive campaign dates
coupon_redempt.csv.role: historical labels and primary response label

hh_demographic.csv.time_role: observation time unverified; excluded from the primary analysis
hh_demographic.csv.role: anonymous static attributes with unverified observation time

causal_data.csv.time_role: weekly store-level exposure without reliable household assignment; excluded
causal_data.csv.role: store display and mailer without reliable household exposure
